title: Elevator_dp
description: Have you always dreamed of building an elevator to hide a secret base?
body:
# A brand new elevator system: 
place a wool block and drop an ender pearl directly on top of it. Now, when you jump, you'll teleport to the wool of the same color above it _(unlimited range, you just need to activate it with the pearl)_.
And when you crouch, you'll teleport to the wool of the same color below it.


## Tuto

### _**Place a block of wool (any color will do)**_

![Place a block of wool (any color will do)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8373c022b617301569639c6bbd10ae749759f49d.jpeg)

### _**Place an ender pearl on the wool block**_

![Place an ender pearl on the wool block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/924449c78b94c2a8a5fd7b9c3c8b5a4111f639ab.jpeg)

### **_Repeat the same process with yarn of the same color._**

![Repeat the same process with yarn of the same color.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b47b89097c29239cc34b216e0474b6b39827bd8.jpeg)
